column1: # Port type name corpus (bracket-only grammar). Tab-separated. Escapes: \uXXXX for every char outside 0x20-0x7e and for backslash, pipe, comma, tab.

# fields: name; 'term' depth element canonical-under-Builtin, or 'syntax' Fault position. A kind prefixed 'map:' is a row of the Map<String,V> term: both readers grade it as the row of the kind after the prefix.
# Derived by hand from the grammar: digits and '_', a leading digit, every printable ASCII character that is not a name character, and malformed bracket shapes.
# Nullable and constructor grammar rows. Both grammars read one lexer; shapes write a nullable level with a leading '?', a constructor as Name(argument) and a parameter as $Name.

# name; 'doc' shape (well-formed in both grammars) | 'decl' shape DocFault DocPosition (well-formed only under the declaration grammar) | 'refused' Fault position (refused by both, alike) | 'declrefused' DeclFault DeclPosition DocFault DocPosition.

# Rows after this line are written by tools/grammar/port-type-names.py from the grammar in docs/reference/port-types.md (Names, Grammar), never from either half. A fault position is the index of the character that stops the sentence; after a '$' the identifier's index. Every 'term' and 'syntax' row above reads the same under the declaration grammar unless its name holds a '$'.

# Map<String,V> term rows. Written by tools/grammar/port-type-names.py like the rows above, each kind prefixed 'map:'. A key is the atom String in any case and nothing else (MapKey); a comma after any other head, a third argument and a bare Map are refused as the other syntax faults.
# Rows for the names Any and Float, which the vocabulary does not hold. 'reserved' rows: a well-formed document term and the reserved name it holds, outermost first ('-' for none).

# A stored term, a registration or a plugin declaration holding a reserved name is refused as port-type-alias, in any case and at any depth. A 'term' row's canonical name above is the vocabulary's: neither Float nor Any is an alias of anything, so each stays as written.
